description: Generate one Content-Derived Design direction from an HTML source, or let Auto choose the strongest direction. Use when the user says /reimagine-it generate, "redesign this page", "make it a landing page", "turn this into an infographic", names a token (all 17: webpage, infographic, svg, 3js, simulation, artistic, cinematic, dashboard, photography, landing, editorial, gradient, showcase, motion, glass, lookbook, particles), or wants a content-aware redesign instead of a mood board. CLI: npx reimagine-it --auto -i page.html -o out.html. Part of the reimagine-it Content-Derived Design suite.
